snippet.title: Quarantine Zone | Launch Trailer - Available NOW
snippet.description:
Hello, everyone!

The day we’ve all been waiting for has finally arrived - Quarantine Zone: The Last Check is OUT! Already available for your enjoyment on Steam with 10% launch discount that will last till January 26th:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419520/Quarantine_Zone_The_Last_Check

We at Brigada Games are extremely happy to announce the launch of our first game and hope that all of you will enjoy your stay in the checkpoint, helping to prevent the spread of the infection.

The game changed greatly since we launched the demo back in May of last year, and we’d like to highlight a few things:
* New tools and improved existing tools are at your disposal
* New tablet UI used for base and resource management, no longer using the cart for manual supply management
* New gameplay elements, such as a science lab that adds more to the core gameplay loop
* New quest system that adds variety to the screening process with specific rules and criteria for letting survivors through
* And so much more for you to uncover

We’re also happy to share that the full release of Quarantine Zone: The Last Check features all-new voiceover work from a talented cast of professional actors. We worked directly with both a professional studio and multiple freelance actors to ensure that each line was delivered exactly as intended. No generative AI is used in Quarantine Zone: The Last Check.

Our team will be looking forward to your feedback and reviews to see which direction we should consider taking the game next, as we finish planning our post-launch content roadmap. In the meantime, we’ll be keeping track of any bug reports and promptly working on fixing any issues that managed to slip past us during pre-release polishing, and we’ll be available to you to try and troubleshoot any issues that might come up.  

See you at the checkpoint!
